query:
INSERT INTO accountingMappings (managementAccountId, accountingCode, accountingName, effectiveDate, endDate, notes, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT ma2.id, am.accountingCode, am.accountingName, am.effectiveDate, am.endDate, am.notes, NOW(), NOW()
FROM accountingMappings am
JOIN managementAccounts ma1 ON am.managementAccountId = ma1.id AND ma1.companyId = 1
JOIN managementAccounts ma2 ON ma2.companyId = 2 AND ma2.code = ma1.code;
